exact_implications.failed_centres_bound: B_X <= constant * N L(X) / X = O(L(X)/log X)
exact_implications.fortune_consequence: all sufficiently large centres succeed; finite prefix checked separately

loss_budget_rules: Every Cauchy-Schwarz step must record its exact X and log X cost.
An estimate with loss comparable to log X does not close the one-failure argument.
A dense-centre average requires a proved restriction theorem for the increasing primorial centres.
Absolute-value control of the residual is stronger than the registered one-sided upper bound.
